def joke_book(ch):
    r = empty(ch.name + '_book', (0.4, -1.1, 3.4), parent=ch.root)
    box(ch.name + '_bookb', (1.1, 0.3, 1.5), (0, 0, 0), mat('book_red', hexc('#c8201e'), 0.5), 0.04, parent=r)
    text(ch.name + '_bookt', 'JOKES', (0, -0.2, 0.2), 0.3, mat('book_ink', hexc('#ffe070'), 0.5), rot=(90, 0, 0), parent=r)
    return r
